metadata.title: Issue #168 Excluded Data Catalog
exclusion_criteria: Treating heartbeat / hourly run receipts as discoveries is strictly prohibited by specification.
Records lacking hypothesis, observation, empirical null test, or invariant formulation are classified as operational telemetry.
Pure runner status ticks are excluded from the Invariant Graph to prevent semantic mirror bloat.
